releaseName: Kisan Mausam v1.9.0 - Account Phone Security, Pinned Hazard Warning & El Niño Outlook Edition
changelog:
• Registered Account Phone Security: Locked mobile number against editing or overwriting in Settings once an account is created
• Pinned Weather Warning Header: Always-visible top bar and hazard warning that compacts on scroll and opens a floating multi-hazard overlay panel
• Revised Home Screen: Saturated AA-compliant Weather Hero Card, 2×2 Field Conditions Grid, NOAA CPC / IRI El Niño (ENSO) Season Card, 30-Day Seasonal Outlook Card, and Inline Top 3 ICAR Crop Recommendations
